bullets.title: Goldman: MSFT added to Conviction Buy; AVGO, NOW removed
bullets.body: Goldman Sachs refreshed its US Conviction List this morning: Microsoft added, Broadcom and ServiceNow removed. NOW traded +3.7% despite the delistment; MSFT is seen benefiting from Azure acceleration (43% YoY, 45% guided) and 30M Copilot seats. AMAT also added to the list per separate reports.

bullets.title: Hyperscalers rally; MS shifts to Mid-Cycle, favors AMZN/MSFT/GOOGL over semis
bullets.body: AMZN +1.6%, MSFT +1.8%, GOOGL +1.7% in premarket after strong prints; AMZN hits $3T market cap. Morgan Stanley's Mike Wilson formally shifts from Early to Mid Cycle, arguing hyperscalers have outperformed semis 20% over last 4 weeks and should maintain leadership; S&P 500 target 8,000 year-end. Cloud capex growth now pegged at +29% YoY CY27 vs. +14% prior.

bullets.title: AMD F2Q26 preview: Street at $11.31B rev, $1.62 EPS; Data Center key watch
bullets.body: AMD reports after close Aug 4; consensus expects $11.31B revenue vs. $11.2B guidance midpoint, Data Center $6.50B, EPS $1.62. UBS models slightly above at $11.33B/$1.65 with DC GPU at $2.75B. Key focus: Helios/MI450 ramp timing, TSMC 3nm wafer allocation, and Q3 guide (Street at $12.53B). AMD +36.6% since May 5; options imply ~10% move.

bullets.title: Semis broadly weak in premarket; memory names hit hardest
bullets.body: Memory complex selling off sharply: WDC -4.4%, STX -4.3%, MU -4.1%, SNDK -3.9%. Broader semi/interconnect weakness: ALAB -3.6%, MRVL -3.4%, LITE -3.3%, ANET -3.3%, LRCX -2.7%. Morgan Stanley notes semis unlikely to reclaim sustained 2026 leadership even if near-term bounce occurs. Chinese CXMT planning second DRAM fab in Beijing, adding competitive overhang for MU/SNDK.

bullets.title: NVDA/AVGO: Morgan Stanley sees both as winners across all open/closed AI model scenarios
bullets.body: MS open-weight AI model analysis concludes NVDA and power infrastructure win in all three scenarios (closed, hybrid, open-weights). AVGO wins specifically in the closed-model scenario. 63% of enterprises already use open-weight models alongside closed models; average AI task delivers $55 benefit vs. $2-5 cost, supporting long adoption runway.

bullets.title: PLTR: UBS Buy at $200 PT; Q2 US commercial ~$716M the key metric to watch
bullets.body: UBS maintains Buy on PLTR with $200 PT (72x 2027 FCF) despite stock -32% YTD. Q2 US commercial revenue expected ~$716M, a ~20% sequential rebound representing +133% YoY growth; this is the pivotal metric investors are watching. Management argues operating-system focus creates durable moat vs. standalone LLMs from OpenAI/Anthropic/Databricks.

bullets.title: SPOT Q2 preview: Evercore OW, expects inline quarter with conservative +6M sub guide
bullets.body: Spotify reports Aug 4 pre-open; Street expects EUR2.76 EPS and EUR4.79B revenue. Evercore (Outperform) sees inline results with 14% YoY revenue growth and an 80bps FX headwind vs. 600bps in Q1. Subscriber guidance of +6M viewed as conservative; Q3 margin tailwinds from premium mix and FX. MS notes +6-7M net adds in Q2 guidance with a 30-40bps regulatory headwind in Q3.

bullets.title: WDC reports Q4 tomorrow; consensus $3.70B rev, $3.31 EPS, options imply 14% move
bullets.body: Western Digital reports Aug 4; consensus expects $3.70B revenue vs. $3.65B +/-$100M guidance, EPS $3.31 vs. $3.25 +/-$0.15 guide, gross margin 51.6%. Q1 FY2027 guide expected at $4.06B revenue. WDC +25.4% since Q3 close; beat consensus 16/20 quarters on revenue, 17/20 on EPS.

bullets.title: RBLX: JPM initiates Neutral at $40; Macquarie downgrades to Neutral, cuts PT to $37
bullets.body: JPMorgan assumed coverage of Roblox with Neutral rating and $40 price target. Separately, Macquarie downgraded RBLX to Neutral from Outperform, slashing PT to $37 from $80.

bullets.title: AMZN: Roth MKM raises PT to $325; stock at 52-week high, +21.4% YTD
bullets.body: Roth MKM raised AMZN price target to $325 from $300 following the strong Q2 report. AMZN hit a new 52-week high at $284.30, +21.4% YTD, driven by fifth consecutive quarter of cloud revenue acceleration and revenue growth outpacing incremental capex per StreetAccount.

bullets.title: HUBS Q2 preview: 20-consecutive-quarter beat streak, options imply ~18% move
bullets.body: HubSpot reports this week; consensus expects Q2 revenue $898.3M (inline with $897-898M guidance), EPS $3.02, non-GAAP operating margin 19.3%. Revenue and EPS have each beaten consensus 20 consecutive quarters. FY guidance $3.70-3.71B. Options imply a ~17.8% post-earnings move; short interest 10%.

bullets.title: SNOW at 52-week high (+39.4% YTD); Hedgeye flags as top long signal
bullets.body: Snowflake hit a new 52-week high at $311.50, up 6.2% on the day and +39.4% YTD per StreetAccount. Hedgeye's fractal signal model separately identifies SNOW as a top long alongside PINS and NET, with positive signals across both short- and medium-term durations.

bullets.title: TSLA: Stifel cuts PT to $491 (from $508), keeps Buy; Europe July registrations mixed
bullets.body: Stifel trimmed Tesla's PT to $491 from $508, maintaining Buy, citing Q2 gross margin decline to 16.8% and adjusted EBITDA miss. European July data is noisy: registrations surged 86% in France and 52% in Denmark but cratered 97% in Norway and 81% in Spain—context note: Tesla's delivery wave strategy means July is characteristically the lightest month of the quarter.

bullets.title: INTU: Podcast argues 60% peak-to-trough derate overdone; 85-90% QuickBooks share a durable moat
bullets.body: Market Voices podcast makes contrarian case for Intuit: stock fallen ~60% from peak to ~16x P/E while revenue growth remains 15% and operating profit growth ~30% with double-digit guidance maintained. QuickBooks holds estimated 85-90% of US small business accounting market; proprietary financial data (lending, payroll, payments) deepens moat. Mailchimp cited as weakest asset.

bullets.title: BABA: Qwen3.8-Max launch claims parity with Anthropic Claude; stock +3.9% premarket
bullets.body: Alibaba released Qwen3.8-Max, claiming competitive performance with Anthropic's top model and lowest price point among well-known models per research firm data. BABA trading +3.9% in premarket on the news. Separately, a social media account notes BABA +35% from a recent call.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Signs 15-year PPA with RWE for 155MW solar; construction starts 2026, ops 2028
bullets.body: Google and RWE signed a 15-year power purchase agreement for the full output of the 155-megawatt Crooked Creek Solar project in McCurtain County, Oklahoma. RWE will begin construction later in 2026; commercial operations expected 2028. Adds to GOOGL's renewable energy portfolio underpinning data center expansion.

bullets.title: EXPE Q2 preview: $4.17B revenue, $5.22 EPS; options imply ~11% move
bullets.body: Expedia reports Q2 on Aug 5; consensus expects revenue $4.17B vs. guidance $4.11-4.19B, bookings $32.96B, EPS $5.22. EXPE +16.6% since May close. Revenue beaten 15/20 quarters, EPS 16/20; options imply ~10.7% move. Last four quarter moves: -9%, -6%, +18%, +4%.

bullets.title: ORCL: Jefferies hosts data center expert call; AI-driven OCI expansion in focus
bullets.body: Jefferies hosted a call today with a 20+ year hyperscale data center expert focused on Oracle's OCI expansion, AI data center buildouts, and power/supply chain dynamics. Oracle is separately cited by StreetAccount as faring well after facing heavy AI capex ROIC scrutiny, alongside Meta.

bullets.title: PANW and CRWD top Oppenheimer cybersecurity checks; AI opportunity seen as FY27+ story
bullets.body: Oppenheimer July cybersecurity channel checks show healthy overall demand with solid pipeline and growing AI tailwinds, but elevated investor expectations limit near-term upside. PANW and CrowdStrike were standout performers; Okta and SentinelOne improving; Zscaler mixed. Meaningful AI monetization opportunity likely not until FY27 or beyond.

bullets.title: RH: BofA reinstates Underperform at $156 PT
bullets.body: Bank of America reinstated coverage of RH (Restoration Hardware) with an Underperform rating and a $156 price target alongside a similar underperform reinstatement on BBY at $80 PT.
